layers.process: Volcán Barú National Park: MiAmbiente's notice (undated on the page; it mentions COVID-era measures) says entry needs a prior booking, with up to 60 visitors a day via the Los Llanos control post (Tierras Altas, 4:00 to 13:00) and 75 visitors and 15 vehicles a day via Camiseta (Boquete). The route from Paso Ancho to the summit must be done with a responsible guide and in good health. Bookings by email or phone given on the notice. Caps may have changed since.

National park entry in Panama is booked and paid through MiAmbiente's online system, which requires accepting Resolución DM-0173-2026 (24 April 2026, Gaceta Oficial 30516 of 4 May 2026). Its fee table was not read. An earlier MiAmbiente notice (1 March 2022, Resolución DM-0182-2020) listed Volcán Barú at B/7.00 for foreigners (children to 12 free) and B/4.00 for nationals and resident foreigners; marine parks B/20.00 for foreigners. B/7.00 is about A$9.94 at par with the US dollar and RBA, 30 October 2026, A$1 = US$0.7040. Treat these as out of date until the 2026 table is read.
